pageProps.title: Linux DRM - Architecture and the Big Picture
pageProps.review: Explaining the background and overall architecture of the Linux DRM (Direct Rendering Manager), /dev/dri device nodes (card, renderD) and permissions, and core structures drm_driver, drm_device, and drm_file based on Linux v6.19 source code.
pageProps.description: An overview of the Linux Direct Rendering Manager (DRM): why it exists, the user and kernel stack, the /dev/dri device nodes, and the core structures drm_driver, drm_device and drm_file in Linux v6.19.
